sections.text: I'm Locked On to Your Heart♪

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Deal magic damage (Water) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 160. Paralyzes for 30 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 160. Confuses for 30 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 160. Blinds for 30 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.

[Aqours] Mari Ohara or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
